title: Security Integration Scope Clarification & Acceptance Checklist for SSO/RBAC/KMS/HSM
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Clarify final requirements and acceptance criteria for SSO (SAML 2.0), RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM integration for Redwood Private deployments. Produce a sign-off checklist and decision log that Engineering, Security, and Product can use to gateprivate/VPC launches.
problem_statement: Customers deploying Redwood Private request enterprise-grade identity, key custody, and audit capabilities. Ambiguity remains around required SAML flows, SCIM provisioning, granular RBAC roles vs. coarse roles, audit retention windows, and whether BYOK HSM is mandatory for GA. Without clarified acceptance criteria, on-prem releases risk rework and failed audits.
out_of_scope: Full SCIM provisioning feature implementation for all identity providers (we will support SCIM v2 for priority IdPs only)
Hardware procurement guidance for customer HSMs
Long-term legal contract language (handled by Legal separately)
scope: SAML 2.0 SP integration with metadata upload and metadata refresh flow
SP-initiated and IdP-initiated login flows verified against three example IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin)
RBAC: implement role model with at least Admin / Operator / Viewer roles + resource-scoped entitlements for Projects and Keys
Audit logging pipeline: immutable event store, search index, and retention policy configuration (90 days default)
KMS/HSM: support both AWS KMS and customer BYOK HSM via PKCS#11 bridge; key rotation and key usage audit events
requirements: REQ-01: SAML metadata upload UI must accept IdP metadata XML and validate certificate fingerprints
REQ-02: Login flows must set user.email, user.name, and groups claims; group->role mapping configurable in Console
REQ-03: SCIM v2 endpoint for provisioning with 2xx success metrics and delta sync support (initial scope: Okta, Azure AD)
REQ-04: RBAC must enforce least privilege; API tokens inherit RBAC rules and appear in audit logs
REQ-05: Audit logs must record actor, action, resource, request_id, timestamp, idp_assertion_id (if available)
REQ-06: Audit retention configurable per deployment (min 30 days, default 90, max 365), and exportable to customer SIEM (syslog/OCI/CloudWatch)
REQ-07: KMS integration must support envelope encryption: customer-managed keys for model payloads and secrets encryption
REQ-08: HSM support via PKCS#11 with documented connector and fallback to cloud KMS when HSM unavailable
REQ-09: Security review required for BYOK onboarding with checklist for key custody, rotation schedule, and emergency rollback
non_functional_requirements: NFR-01: SSO login latency < 800ms p95 for cached IdP metadata path
NFR-02: Audit log ingestion < 5s from event generation to index for internal pipeline
NFR-03: RBAC decision evaluation added to request path with < 2ms median overhead
NFR-04: KMS operations availability >= 99.95% (subject to customer KMS SLA), with graceful degradation mode for transient KMS errors
NFR-05: All keys in transit use TLS1.3; at-rest keys stored encrypted using a cluster root key managed by HSM or cloud KMS
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: End-to-end SAML login tests pass (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated) for Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin in staging
AC-02: Console UI allows mapping a group to a Redwood role and that mapping controls access to a protected route in runtime
AC-03: SCIM provisioning round-trip creates/updates/deactivates a user and records events in audit logs
AC-04: Audit log contains required fields (actor, action, resource, request_id, timestamp) for 100% of tested control-plane operations
AC-05: KMS: perform a BYOK round-trip where a customer HSM key encrypts a secret and Redwood can decrypt via the PKCS#11 connector; all key-usage events are logged
AC-06: Pen test checklist item for auth bypass resolved with mitigation before sign-off
AC-07: Compliance evidence package generated (config screenshots, audit samples, signed runbook) and uploaded to Confluence link in ticket
signoff_checklist: PM: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria documented and prioritized
Security: Threat model reviewed and critical issues remediated
Engineering: Implementation completed and automated E2E tests added to CI
SRE/Ops: Runbook for KMS failover and audit export validated
Legal/Privacy: Data residency and key custody language reviewed
QA: Acceptance tests green in staging and pre-prod
Customer Success: Customer onboarding checklist validated for BYOK customers
